card.name: Linking words after estrogen cancer terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "in", "of" or "and" right after a medical noun phrase, mostly "in" after "endometrial cancer" in estrogen-alone boxed warnings. Also blank spaces in vaccination schedule tables.

modes.label: Estrogen warning "in"
modes.description: The word "in" after a risk or event phrase, just before "a woman" or "women".
modes.example: There is an increased risk of endometrial cancer<< in>> a woman with a uterus who uses un

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: "and" or "of" after a noun in agency names or study titles.
modes.example: Animal<< and>> Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS),

modes.label: Vaccine schedule gaps
modes.description: A space token inside a vaccination schedule table before "6 months".

card.writes: Weakly pushes toward compensation-type words and away from milk and lactation words.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words like "in" after "endometrial cancer" in estrogen warnings.
